scope: Anonymous access only; European top-five first divisions; continuous tracking and usable possession supervision required for full pipeline testing

sources.name: IDSSE/Sportec primary release and PySport mirror
sources.finding: Release has two first-division and five second-division matches; mirror is not a new independent first-division source. Existing WMX/WN1 retained; second division excluded.

sources.name: Historical SkillCorner first-division data
sources.finding: Replay the five already-audited historical training games4039/3749/3518/2068/2440. Four other previously-seen games are not added to this fitting pool. Partial H/A supervision, not full H/A/D ground truth.
sources.license: Historical MIT revision, existing source audit preserved
sources.used_in_083: 20percent sampled training windows from existing five-game fitting pool

sources.name: IMPECT open data
sources.finding: Bundesliga2023/24 event data, KPIs and lineups; not continuous all-player/ball tracking with frame possession labels.
sources.license: Provider-specific LICENSE.pdf terms; not accepted or used in this experiment

sources.name: SoccerTrack v2
sources.finding: Official project describes ten university-level amateur matches, outside the requested top-five-league scope.

sources.name: SoccerNet GSR2024 public subset
sources.finding: Public athlete game-state clips are available, but the primary benchmark paper excludes the ball from pitch reconstruction/ignores ball detections. Continuous ball tracking plus possession reference was not verified. Cannot supply the complete inputs/targets required here.
sources.license: Dataset card reports GPL3.0; not used

sources.name: SoccerNet newer catalogue and ball-action tasks
sources.finding: Ball-action task repositories listed as NDA-gated are excluded by anonymous-only scope. GSR2027catalogue lead could not be verified as an accessible suitable dataset; no data acquired or counted.
sources.license: Not accepted; no gated downloads attempted

augmentation.matches: The same two licensed Bundesliga matches
augmentation.meaning: Two additional random error draws per half per match. Additional observation variants, not new matches or independent tests.

limitation: Search is not proof that no other data exists. No new anonymous, licensed top-five continuous tracking plus full possession-reference match was verified for this run. No downloads requiring sign-in/acceptance were attempted.
